If the bidder is not a manufacturer of the material, the bidder must be an authorized dealer of the concern manufacturer. In t his regard, copy of authorization certificate to be attached with the offer.

b) The bidder must provide references regarding supply of the material for Amine Treating Unit/ Amine Reg eneration Unit of Indian Refinery/Petrochemical/ Fertiliser or other comparable process industries. The mat erial shall be used for amine gas treating to remove H2S from sour gas stream. The detail references inclu ding the copy of the purchase order to be attached with the offer. Minimum one reference of supply for ami ne treating unit of Indian Refinery/ Petrochemical/ Fertiliser or other comparable process industries is requi red. * Relaxation of PTR for MSE/Startups shall not be applicable for this tender TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION OF THE MATERIAL: A. The specification of Methyldiethanolamine (MDEA to be supplied must match the below: 1. Physical state: Clear Liquid 2. Methyldiethanolamine (MDEA) weight content: 99.8% min 3. Water content: 0.2% max 4. Odour: Ammonic 5. Specific Gravity (@ 25 Deg C): 1.03-1.09 6. Boiling point: 245-250 °C 7. Melting point (deg. C): -21 °C min 8. Flash Point: 135°C min 9. pH (full strength): 11.5 (approx.) 10. Solubility in water at 20°C: 100% 11. Purpose of Use: For H2S absorption in Amine Treating Unit for sweetening of sour refinery off- gas. B. Shelf life of the material should be minimum 2 years. Delivery Period: The supply to be made in 2 batches. First batch of 15000 kg to be delivered within 1 (on e)month of placement of PO and the balance 13000 kg to be delivered after 4(four)months of delivery of th e first batch. For detailed technical specification and SCC, bidder shall refer to buyer uploaded bid specific A TC for compliance and guidance. . 5.
